meta.subject: fix scheduler rename_table X values - reverted valid bits

en.summary: Fixes scheduler rename tracking by making the rename table the only source of dependency truth and clearing it on reset.
why_it_counts: The RTL change is focused on scheduler hazard logic.
The subject explicitly describes a rename-table correctness bug.
The patch directly changes reset and writeback handling of dependency state.
disqualifiers: The commit also updates build and simulator support files.
evidence: VX_scheduler.v removes valid_table from rename qualification.
Writeback invalidation only masks rename_table bits instead of maintaining separate valid metadata.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A rename tracker or scoreboard needs one coherent source of truth for outstanding destination state. If hazard checks depend on a second valid table that is not reset and invalidated in lockstep with the real rename mask, stale or unknown metadata can create false dependencies and unpredictable issue behavior.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: After reset or partial writeback, duplicated rename-valid metadata drifts out of sync with the real rename mask.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reintroduce a separate valid-bit table and keep hazard checks dependent on it while no longer fully clearing rename state on reset.
portability_notes: Apply this to any scheduler or scoreboard that tracks outstanding destination registers.
The reusable bug is stale dependency-valid metadata, not the Vortex table names.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the structure that records pending destination masks.
Add or restore a second validity table that gates hazard checks.
Stop fully clearing the rename state on reset or stop updating the secondary table consistently on writeback.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: scheduler rename_table hazard tracking and reset logic
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix removes valid_table, resets rename_table, and uses rename_table nonzero checks as the only rename-valid condition.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Reintroduce valid_table qualification for rs1_rename/rs2_rename/rd_rename and stop clearing rename_table on reset.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The scheduler can see false dependencies after reset or partial writeback, causing spurious stalls, delayed issue, or nondeterministic scheduling.
evidence_for_injection: The pre-fix design used both rename_table and valid_table in hazard checks.
The reset path previously did not clear rename_table.
The fix collapses state into rename_table alone to eliminate X and stale-valid divergence.
notes: This is a localized RTL mutation.
The build and simulator edits in the same commit are not part of the injected fault.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了调度器中的 rename 跟踪问题：让 rename table 成为依赖状态的唯一真值来源，并在 reset 时清零。
why_it_counts: RTL 改动集中在调度器 hazard 逻辑。
提交标题明确描述了 rename table 的正确性 bug。
补丁直接修改了依赖状态的 reset 和 writeback 更新方式。
disqualifiers: 该提交还更新了构建和模拟器配套文件。
evidence: VX_scheduler.v 从 rename 判定中删除了 valid_table。
writeback 失效路径只再更新 rename_table mask，而不再维护独立的 valid 元数据。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: rename tracker 或 scoreboard 必须只有一个一致的真值来源来表示未完成目标状态。如果 hazard 检查依赖另一张没有和真实 rename mask 同步 reset 与失效的 valid 表，就可能因为陈旧或未知元数据产生伪相关和不稳定的发射行为。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 在 reset 之后或部分 writeback 之后，重复的 rename-valid 元数据与真实 rename mask 失配。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 重新引入独立 valid-bit 表，并让 hazard 检查继续依赖它，同时不再在 reset 时彻底清空 rename 状态。
portability_notes: 适用于任何跟踪飞行中目标寄存器的 scheduler 或 scoreboard。
可复用缺陷的本质是依赖有效性元数据陈旧，而不是 Vortex 的表名。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到记录待写回目标 mask 的结构。
增加或恢复一张独立的 valid 表来参与 hazard 判定。
停止在 reset 时彻底清空 rename 状态，或者在 writeback 时不再一致更新这张辅助表。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: scheduler 中 rename_table 的 hazard 跟踪与 reset 逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复删除了 valid_table、在 reset 时清零 rename_table，并且只用 rename_table 是否非零来判断 rename 依赖。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复 rs1_rename/rs2_rename/rd_rename 对 valid_table 的联合判定，并停止在 reset 时清零 rename_table。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 调度器会在 reset 或部分 writeback 后看到伪造的寄存器相关性，导致无谓停顿、发射延迟或不稳定调度。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前 hazard 检查同时依赖 rename_table 和 valid_table。
旧的 reset 路径不会清零 rename_table。
本次修复把状态收敛到 rename_table 单一来源，以避免 X 值和陈旧 valid 失配。
notes: 这是一个局部 RTL 变异点。
同一提交中的构建和模拟器改动不属于注入故障的一部分。
